mother.definition: A female parent who raises or cares for a child.
mother.exampleUsage: My mother called to ask about my new job.

father.definition: A male parent who raises or cares for a child.
father.exampleUsage: Her father helped her move into the apartment.

sister.definition: A female sibling in a family.
sister.exampleUsage: My sister visits me after work.

brother.definition: A male sibling in a family.
brother.exampleUsage: My brother brings lunch for us.

son.definition: Someone’s male child, including an adult son.
son.exampleUsage: Her son is thirty and works in another city.

daughter.definition: Someone’s female child, including an adult daughter.
daughter.exampleUsage: Their daughter calls them after work.

parents.definition: The people who have the parental role in a family.
parents.exampleUsage: My parents are visiting this weekend.

siblings.definition: Brothers and sisters in the same family.
siblings.exampleUsage: My siblings live in different cities.

baby.exampleUsage: My brother holds his baby daughter.

twin.definition: One of two children born from the same pregnancy.
twin.exampleUsage: My twin and I have the same birthday.

mom.definition: An informal word for a female parent.
mom.exampleUsage: I called my mom after work.

dad.definition: An informal word for a father.
dad.exampleUsage: I call my dad after work.

big-sister.definition: An older female sibling, especially when described in relation to a younger brother or sister.
big-sister.exampleUsage: Her big sister helped her with homework.

little-brother.exampleUsage: His little brother likes building toy models.
little-brother.definition: A younger male sibling in a family.

oldest-child.definition: The child in a family who was born before all the other children.
oldest-child.exampleUsage: She is the oldest child in the family.

youngest-child.definition: The child in a family who was born after all the other children.
youngest-child.exampleUsage: He is the youngest child in the family.

middle-child.definition: A child who has at least one older sibling and at least one younger sibling.
middle-child.exampleUsage: The middle child has an older sister and a younger brother.

only-child.definition: A person who has no brothers or sisters.
only-child.exampleUsage: She grew up as an only child.

stepmother.definition: A woman married to one of your parents who is not your mother.
stepmother.exampleUsage: Nadia introduces her father’s wife Sara as her stepmother.

stepfather.definition: A man married to one of your parents who is not your father.
stepfather.exampleUsage: Maya introduces her mother’s husband as her stepfather.

family-dinner.definition: A meal eaten together by members of a family.
family-dinner.exampleUsage: Everyone sat together for a family dinner.

game-night.definition: An evening set aside for playing board games, card games, or other family games.
game-night.exampleUsage: The family holds a game night on Fridays.

road-trip.definition: A long journey made by road, usually by car, often with several stops.
road-trip.exampleUsage: The family planned a road trip during the holiday.

holiday-gathering.definition: A social meeting of relatives or friends held to celebrate a holiday.
holiday-gathering.exampleUsage: Relatives met for a holiday gathering.

movie-night.definition: An evening spent watching a film together as a social activity.
movie-night.exampleUsage: The family chose a comedy for movie night.

cooking-together.definition: The activity of preparing food as a group.
cooking-together.exampleUsage: Cooking together gave everyone a small task.

bedtime-story.definition: A story read or told to a child shortly before sleep.
bedtime-story.exampleUsage: The parent read a bedtime story.

morning-routine.definition: The usual activities you do after waking up to start your day.
morning-routine.exampleUsage: Breakfast is part of my morning routine.

family-photo.definition: A photograph showing several members of a family together.
family-photo.exampleUsage: They took a family photo at the celebration.

homework-help.definition: Assistance with understanding and completing school assignments.
homework-help.exampleUsage: Maya offers homework help to a visiting relative.

love.definition: A strong feeling of affection and care.
love.exampleUsage: Nadia shows love by listening and offering help.

trust.definition: Confidence that someone is honest, reliable, and will treat you well.
trust.exampleUsage: Trust grows when family members keep their promises.

support.definition: Help, encouragement or practical assistance given to someone.
support.exampleUsage: Her brother offers support during a difficult decision.

care.definition: Attention to someone’s needs and well-being.
care.exampleUsage: Their parents show care by asking what she needs.

protection.definition: The act of keeping someone safe from harm or danger.
protection.exampleUsage: The family offered protection during a difficult time.

guidance.definition: Advice or help with making a choice or finding a direction.
guidance.exampleUsage: Nadia asks her family for guidance before deciding.

discipline.definition: Self-control and following fair rules of behaviour.
discipline.exampleUsage: Fair discipline helps the family keep household rules.

affection.definition: A feeling of liking and fondness for someone.
affection.exampleUsage: They show affection through kind words.

bond.definition: A close connection between people who care about one another.
bond.exampleUsage: They share a strong family bond.

heritage.definition: Traditions, values, and history passed down from earlier generations.
heritage.exampleUsage: The family celebrates its cultural heritage.
